Our vehicles are electric, but our Mechanics are very practical! We don't use a laptop to find the issue; our Mechanics identify it ourselves. Unlike many modern vehicles, our vehicle still requires real hands-on work. Our EPVs are practical delivery vehicles that are used intensively every day, which means craftsmanship, mechanical knowledge and problem-solving are still big parts of the Mechanic job at Picnic. You'll be working on the Goupil G4 and G6: compact delivery vehicles that may look small, but work tirelessly every day to get groceries to our customers. These are vehicles with character, and our experienced mechanics ensure they are up and running each day.  The Tricks of the Trade  - Problem solving: Troubleshooting issues with our vehicles and fixing them yourself. - Independence: Drive your own route everyday and set up shop at our hubs from your mobile service van. - Collaboration: Collaborate with teams across the Netherlands to ensure our vehicles are ready to deliver groceries to our customers. - Ownership: You'll carry out maintenance and repairs on site, repair cargo boxes where necessary, perform your own final checks, and keep your paperwork in order.
